bugs_found.root_cause: Python non-empty string 'unknown' is truthy. row.get('is_binding_site', False) evaluated True for 'unknown', awarding +4 structural score points to every spatially unresolved variant.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: CHRNA7: is_binding_site={'unknown': 961}. ALL 961 variants received spurious +4 binding-site bonus. Rankings were invalid.
bugs_found.fix: Changed all structural feature checks to == True (not 'is True'). This correctly evaluates: bool True -> True, float 1.0 (post-CSV) -> True, string 'unknown' -> False, NaN -> False.

bugs_found.root_cause: Spatially unresolved variants were assigned is_interface=False and is_tm_core=False. This conflates UNKNOWN with FALSE: a variant that cannot be assessed is treated as definitively NOT at the interface. Enrichment denominators were inflated.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: CHRNA7 has 238 spatially unresolved variants. All got is_interface=False. This added 238 false-negatives to the D cell of the enrichment table.
bugs_found.fix: Changed all unresolved-variant flags to 'unknown'. Applies to is_interface, is_tm_core, is_pore_region, is_transmembrane. Three-state semantics now explicit: True=positive, False=assessed-negative, 'unknown'=cannot-assess.

bugs_found.root_cause: WebSocket handler sent {'type': 'pipeline_complete'} unconditionally after the step for-loop, even when a step failed and caused a break. The send_json call was positioned after the loop body at the same indentation level.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: Character position analysis: 'if not success' at char 3954, 'pipeline_complete' at char 4052. Message sent regardless of break.
bugs_found.fix: Added pipeline_succeeded boolean. Set False on any step failure, send pipeline_failed with message. Only send pipeline_complete when all steps succeed.

bugs_found.root_cause: Frontend SummaryPanel checked r.status === 'computed' to detect enrichment success, but structural_enrichment_ci.py produces {"status": "success"}. Status key never matched. Enrichment UI was permanently empty.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: CHRNA7 enrichment JSON: {"feature": "is_pore_core", "status": "success", "odds_ratio": 13.4, "p_value": 9.1e-05}. This OR=13.4 (p<0.001) result was never displayed.
bugs_found.fix: All occurrences of r.status === 'computed' updated to r.status === 'success' (3 locations). Added pipeline_failed handler in WebSocket message receiver.

bugs_found.root_cause: AF=0.0 used as default for variants with no gnomAD frequency. Module 2 Phase A corrects this but Module 1 CSV retains corrupt AF data.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: CHRNA7 Module 1 output: AF==0.0 count=438, AF>0 count=0.
bugs_found.fix: Documented as known limitation. Module 2 Phase A overwrites AF with correct gnomAD values. M1 CSV is intermediate only.

bugs_found.root_cause: Phase A AF re-filtering hardcoded threshold 0.001. Config af_threshold parameter was read and stored but never passed to phase_a_coordinate_correction(). User-configured thresholds had no effect.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: Line 128 original: df[(df['gnomAD_AF'].isna()) | (df['gnomAD_AF'] < 0.001)]. config['af_threshold'] was read but unused in this step.
bugs_found.fix: Added af_threshold parameter to phase_a_coordinate_correction(). Caller extracts config.get('af_threshold', 0.001) and passes it. Filter now uses configured value.

bugs_found.root_cause: Domain name comparison used uppercase string literal 'M2'. Module 2 assigns domain names in lowercase ('m2'). Comparison always failed.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: if domain == 'M2': always False because domain values are 'm2', 'extracellular_domain', etc.
bugs_found.fix: Changed to: if str(domain).lower() == 'm2': Radial distance from pentamer center now correctly computed for pore-region variants.

bugs_found.root_cause: Variable 'data' assigned inside 'if r.status_code == 200' block. Next line 'ids = data.get(...)' was at parent indentation level, executing on non-200 responses where data was undefined. NameError silently caught by outer except.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: Indentation analysis: ids = data.get() at same level as if-block, not inside it.
bugs_found.fix: Moved ids = data.get() and entire fetch block inside the if r.status_code == 200 scope. Added else clause to log HTTP error codes.

bugs_found.root_cause: Binding-site enrichment was skipped when ANY variant had is_binding_site='unknown'. Since spatially unresolved variants always get 'unknown', this condition fired on every run regardless of whether a ligand was present. Could not distinguish 'no ligand' from 'ligand present but some variants unresolved'.
bugs_found.empirical_evidence: PAH has ligands H4B + FE2 + SO4 (mapping_report ligand_available=True). 45 variants have is_binding_site=1.0. Enrichment was still marked skipped as 'no ligand available'.
bugs_found.fix: Skip only when no True/False binding-site values exist (bs_has_assessed=False). Added second skip condition: ligand detected but no variants within distance threshold. Contingency table now uses == True / == False to exclude 'unknown' values from cells.

remaining_limitations: No multiple testing correction for 3 simultaneous enrichment tests.
Ensembl/gnomAD API results not versioned; different query dates may yield different variants.
Random downsampling seed hardcoded at 42; not configurable via config panel.
Crystallographic additives (SO4, glycerol, ions) counted as ligands; biological relevance not verified automatically.
Only chain A used for spatial computations; valid for homomers but documented.
SIFTS mapping queried live in both Module 3 and Module 5 independently.
Module-level code execution in all pipeline scripts prevents unit testing without full pipeline execution.
Dead legacy scripts (phase_b_structural.py, phase_c_functional.py) not removed; risk of user confusion.
Non-gene-namespaced output files (mod4_output.txt, output_mod5.txt) overwritten on every run.

chrna7.reason_for_drop: AF re-filtering removes variants above af_threshold with real gnomAD data

enrichment_results_verified.note: CHRNA7 pore-core enrichment OR=13.4 was previously invisible in UI due to BUG-04. Now displays correctly.
